note: The official 50-gate brain is taped out on X Layer as circuit #2 on the external Sillu test processor. All 4,096 answers and the stored bytes were checked by the site. The separately created TapeFly processor remains unusable because its NAND price was entered with OKB decimals.
tapeflyProcessorNote: The first TapeFly processor is on X Layer, but its NAND price was entered with OKB decimals and the transistor contract charges the raw value in BEM. It costs 10,000 BEM per NAND and cannot be repaired in place. The site shows the real BEM cost and blocks unaffordable purchases. A replacement processor is required for a normal public tape-out.
